Website privacy

When you visit

The site uses a page-view script from transduction.systems. It sends the path of the page you visit to events.transduction.systems. The script skips this count when your browser sends the ‘Do Not Track’ setting. The hosting service also processes the technical information it needs to deliver and protect the site.

When you email us

Email links open your own email application. The Quadrant Resourcing team receives the information you send in the mailbox you choose.

Before sending sensitive documents, ask for the privacy information that applies to recruitment or to your assignment. For questions about access to your information, how long we keep it, or deletion, email Benjamin Taylor.
